proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H K hH hK hinf hsup
  haveI := hK
  have hc : ∀ (x : H) (y : K), Commute (H.subtype x) (K.subtype y) := fun x y =>
    Subgroup.commute_of_normal_of_disjoint H K hH hK (disjoint_iff.mpr hinf) x y x.2 y.2
  refine ⟨MulEquiv.ofBijective (MonoidHom.noncommCoprod H.subtype K.subtype hc) ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨c, d⟩ he
    have he' : (a : G) * b = c * d := he
    have h1 : (c : G)⁻¹ * a = d * (b : G)⁻¹ := by
      calc (c : G)⁻¹ * a = (c : G)⁻¹ * (a * b) * (b : G)⁻¹ := by group
        _ = (c : G)⁻¹ * (c * d) * (b : G)⁻¹ := by rw [he']
        _ = d * (b : G)⁻¹ := by group
    have hmem : (c : G)⁻¹ * a ∈ H ⊓ K := by
      refine ⟨H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem c.2) a.2, ?_⟩
      rw [h1]
      exact K.mul_mem d.2 (K.inv_mem b.2)
    rw [hinf, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
    have hac : (a : G) = c := by
      have := inv_mul_eq_one.mp hmem
      exact this.symm
    have hbd : (b : G) = d := by
      rw [hac] at he'
      exact mul_left_cancel he'
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hac) (Subtype.ext hbd)
  · intro g
    have hg : g ∈ ((H ⊔ K : Subgroup G) : Set G) := by
      rw [hsup]
      trivial
    rw [Subgroup.mul_normal] at hg
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, e⟩ := Set.mem_mul.mp hg
    exact ⟨(⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩), e⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G), H.Normal → K.Normal → H ⊓ K = ⊥ → H ⊔ K = ⊤ → Nonempty ((H × K) ≃* G)
